title: Connecting Human Behavior and Social Robotics at ETH Zurich
summary: A June research visit opened conversations across human-centered AI, social robotics, and human behavior.

sources.label: Read Chorong Park's original LinkedIn post

paragraphs.text: Chorong Park's June visit to ETH Zurich brought her research into conversation with a group working across human behavior and social robotics. In an August 20, 2026, reflection, she thanked Emily S. Cross and Amol Deshmukh for hosting the exchange.

Park described presenting work on human-centered AI and human-robot interaction, with a focus on aging, trust, autonomy, and meaningful everyday experiences. The visit offered an opportunity to discuss these questions with researchers approaching them from related perspectives.
Her reflection highlighted the intersection of neuroscience, behavior, and social robotics. The photographs show the presentation and discussion around a shared meeting table.

Park closed by expressing appreciation for the welcome and interest in continuing the conversation. The account documents an exchange of ideas and potential future collaboration, rather than a new formal agreement.
